🎯 Why this is worth a section rather than a footnote

An engine you cannot inspect is an engine you have to trust. Every table here exists because a specific class of error was invisible without it — a frozen derived field, an invalidation graph that silently stopped filtering, a safety net where half the checks never fired. None of those show up as an error message; they show up as a number that is quietly wrong under a configuration you did not test.

Pure documentation. Nothing here writes to the model, and no control on this page can change a case. The one exception to "everything is derived" is labelled on-screen where it occurs: the mapping of which flag gates which audit-check family is
